integrity: One finite graph, complete C++ enumeration of all 5,852,925 eight-subsets; independent F2 symplectic backtracking census of 111,225 independent eight-subsets and independent exchange graph check; explicit S6 orbit verifier.
scientific_limitations: The exact optimum census, natural S6-orbit enumeration, completion-time profile, and exchange component decomposition concern the single labelled Tutte-Coxeter graph. Sharp decycling size, stable-tree structure, and irreversible two-conversion equivalence are known earlier results, not new claims. Priority cannot be guaranteed against unindexed earlier enumerations; external independent validation has not occurred.
title: Seventy nine-clique islands in optimal contagion on Tutte's eight-cage
